overall_verdict: full-domain canonical-majorant reduction passes; traceless-only extension not established; primary search scoped and does not establish novelty

claims.statement: Let K be self-adjoint on the real Hermitian Hilbert space with K(I)=I. If a trace-preserving EB map Lambda satisfies <A,Lambda(A)>_tau >= <A,K(A)>_tau for every Hermitian A, then Lambda is unital.
assumptions: quadratic-form inequality on all Hermitian A
claims.proof: Set T=(Lambda+Lambda*)/2 and P=T-K. Then P>=0 and <I,PI>_tau=0 by TP and Lambda*(I)=I. Positivity gives PI=0, T(I)=I, and Lambda(I)=I.
claims.critical_scope: Testing only traceless A does not yield the identity slack and does not force unitality.
claims.falsifier: A TP EB Lambda and target K meeting the stated full-domain assumptions for which Lambda(I) != I.

claims.statement: Every full-domain feasible TP EB Lambda admits a canonical POVM channel Gamma with Gamma >= (Lambda+Lambda*)/2 >= K. For a Holevo form with r nonzero terms, Gamma uses at most 2r POVM effects.
assumptions: finite Holevo form Lambda(X)=sum_y Tr(M_y X) sigma_y
claims.proof: Unitality makes N_y=Tr(M_y) sigma_y a POVM alongside M_y. With p_y=Tr(M_y)/d, rho_y=M_y/Tr(M_y), u_y=d sqrt(p_y)rho_y, and v_y=d sqrt(p_y)sigma_y, (Gamma_M+Gamma_N)/2-(Lambda+Lambda*)/2=(1/2)sum_y |u_y-v_y><u_y-v_y|_tau >=0. The average is canonical via the union POVM {M_y/2,N_y/2}.
claims.zero_weight_handling: Omit M_y=0 before defining rho_y; PSD trace-zero effects vanish, and the corresponding N_y is zero.
claims.falsifier: An algebraic normalization/factor error in the displayed rank-one decomposition or a failure of either M or N to sum to I.

claims.statement: For K=2 Phi-I with Phi unital, TP, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint, existence of a full-domain TP EB comparator Lambda with quadratic-form Lambda>=K is equivalent to existence of a canonical comparator. The canonical support inequality for every Q>=0 on traceless Hermitians is necessary and sufficient.
claims.proof: The majorant reduction gives the unrestricted-to-canonical direction. Compact-convex separation gives canonical feasibility iff S_d(Q)>=Tr_HS(QK) for every Q>=0. Both K and canonical maps fix I and are self-adjoint, so H0 domination extends to the full Hermitian space.
claims.compactness_repair: Represent all canonical maps by probability measures over density matrices with barycenter I/d and continuous second moments. Rank-one refinement PSD-dominates each canonical map, so supports and existence of a dominator may also be reduced to rank-one maps. The full canonical set is not equal to the rank-one subset.
claims.falsifier: Failure of compactness/convexity of the canonical moment image, the full-domain majorant lemma, or positive-cone separation equivalence.

claims.statement: The identity-slack proof does not extend directly to comparators constrained only on traceless Hermitians. A qubit pure-state replacer is a nonunital TP EB map satisfying the H0 inequality against K=2 Delta-I, where Delta is the completely depolarizing channel.
assumptions: inequality tested only on traceless A
claims.status: internally verified scope example; not a counterexample to canonical existence
claims.example: Lambda(X)=Tr(X)|0><0| has zero action on traceless inputs, while K=-I there; hence the restricted quadratic-form inequality holds. The canonical depolarizing channel also dominates K, so the example only shows that unitality is not forced.
claims.falsifier: A derivation of unitality from the H0-only premise using no additional assumption, or an arithmetic error in the example.

claims.statement: The majorant has at most 2r effects from a chosen r-term Holevo form; a separable normalized Choi decomposition and Caratheodory give an existential bound of at most 2d^4 effects.
assumptions: real affine Choi state dimension d^4-1
claims.falsifier: A separable normalized Choi state in dimension d^4-1 affine space requiring more than d^4 pure-product terms, or an incorrect outcome doubling.

claims.statement: The bounded primary-source pass located standard Holevo/separable-Choi prior art but no exact statement of the full-domain EB-to-canonical Loewner majorant identity.
assumptions: source search limited to the exact and adjacent terms recorded in SOURCE_NOTES.md
claims.status: scoped literature observation; not a novelty or priority claim
